meta.title: A Drum in a Suitcase
meta.textType: story: the gist of an illustrated story

paragraphs: Tom needed a way to take his drum to school, and Dad had an idea. Tom was in the school band with Ben. On Friday, the band was going to play for the parents. Teacher Nick let Tom borrow a big drum on Monday. Tom wanted to practice every day after school. But the drum was too big for his bike. He carried it home in his arms. It was a long walk.

At home, Tom played the drum in the living room. Pip jumped at every loud sound. Lily stood at the door and looked at her brother. "Please play it in the garden," she said. Tom took the drum out. Pip went with him. Squeaky hid under a leaf. The drum sounded much better outside. By Thursday, Tom was ready.

On Friday morning, Tom asked, "How can I take the drum to school?" "I have an idea," said Dad. He took an old suitcase out of the cupboard. It was full of blankets. Dad took the blankets out and put the drum in the suitcase. Then he put the blankets around the drum to keep it safe. The suitcase had wheels, so Tom could pull it. "Thanks, Dad," said Tom, and he smiled.

Ben laughed when he saw Tom at the school gate. "A drum in a suitcase!" he said. "What a funny idea!" Teacher Nick looked at the suitcase. "It is a very good idea," he said. In the afternoon, the hall was full of parents. Tom took the drum out of the suitcase, and the band began to play. Mom, Dad, and Lily sat at the front and clapped. Tom's drum came to school in a suitcase, and the band played very well.
